title: The Layered Ownership File
brief: A simulated Deutsche Bank Corporate Bank onboarding involves layered entities and an unresolved beneficial owner before a major mandate.
objective: Complete a risk-based ownership review without allowing commercial urgency to weaken KYC evidence.

nodes.speaker: Corporate Onboarding Lead
nodes.message: The client supplied a registry extract, but ownership runs through two offshore entities and the final natural-person owner is not verified. The mandate is expected today.

artifact.title: Priority corporate onboarding
artifact.body: Commercial approval is complete. Beneficial ownership evidence remains incomplete for the final layer.

choices.label: Pause activation, verify the ownership chain and escalate unresolved risk.
choices.consequence: The mandate remains pending until accountable ownership is evidenced and reviewed.

choices.label: Activate the account and collect ownership evidence after the first payment.
choices.consequence: The relationship becomes active before a foundational KYC risk is resolved.

choices.label: Treat the first registry extract as sufficient because it is official.
choices.consequence: The document confirms an entity but does not resolve the ultimate beneficial owner.
